name: Beadnell Towers
accommodation: 22 individually designed bedrooms including Coach House rooms
beachAccess: In Beadnell village, a short walk from the beach
confirmedFeatures: Beadnell Kitchen restaurant, Beadnell Bar, private dining and functions
overview: A boutique hotel in the middle of Beadnell village with 22 individually styled bedrooms, a restaurant serving local produce and a bar. Pet-friendly rooms are available. Beadnell Bay's long sweep of sand is a short walk from the door, and Seahouses is a few minutes along the coast.
surfTripFit: Walkable to the bay with good food on site, it suits surfers who want comfort after a session.
